title: CI: Update dependency awslabs/aws-lc to v1.63.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|
| [awslabs/aws-lc](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc) | minor | `1.61.4` -> `1.63.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>awslabs/aws-lc (awslabs/aws-lc)</summary>

### [`v1.63.0`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.63.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.62.1...v1.63.0)

##### What's Changed

- Fix tpm2-tss CI by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2767](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2767)
- Fix Ruby integration CI by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2765](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2765)
- Migrate Windows Omnibus to GitHub Workflow by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2780](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2780)
- Add compiler to 24.04 docker image by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2783](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2783)
- CI add rpmbuild job by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2774](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2774)
- Failing no-op implementations for several UI functions by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2772](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2772)
- Tool util functions in tool\_util.cc by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2778](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2778)
- AES-XTS on AArch64: Set w19 earlier before cipher-stealing of 1 block + tail. by [@​nebeid](https://redirect.github.com/nebeid) in [aws#2785](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2785)
- Prepare release v1.63.0 by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2789](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2789)

##### Bug fixes

- Fixed a bug in the AES-XTS-256 aarch64 architecture implementation. For input lengths of 17-31 bytes there was a 50% probability that an encryption operation would result in corrupted ciphertext. The resulting ciphertext would result in corrupted plaintext when performing a decrypt operation.

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v1.62.1...v1.63.0>

### [`v1.62.1`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.62.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.62.0...v1.62.1)

##### Post release edit

- This release contains a bug in the AES-XTS implementation on aarch64 platforms affecting input lengths of 17 to 31 bytes.

##### What's Changed

- Implement ecparam CLI tool by [@​kingstjo](https://redirect.github.com/kingstjo) in [aws#2718](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2718)
- CodeBuild Setup for GitHub Docker Image Builds by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2745](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2745)
- Add Docker Image Build Workflows by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2746](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2746)
- Add ecr:BatchImportUpstreamImage for first-time cache pull-thru by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2747](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2747)
- Use New Docker Images in GitHub Workflows by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2752](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2752)
- Add OPENSSL\_NO\_UI\_CONSOLE macro by [@​smittals2](https://redirect.github.com/smittals2) in [aws#2751](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2751)
- Cipher-stealing: no need for re-loading round keys; they're still in registers. by [@​nebeid](https://redirect.github.com/nebeid) in [aws#2734](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2734)
- Fix windows CI job by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2744](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2744)
- Consolidate GitHub CodeBuild Projects by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2757](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2757)
- Don't log feature probe error message unless requested by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2755](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2755)
- Implement more options for x509 CLI by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2735](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2735)
- AWS CodeBuild Fleets Setup by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2758](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2758)
- ci: scope down GitHub Token permissions by [@​AdnaneKhan](https://redirect.github.com/AdnaneKhan) in [aws#2762](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2762)
- Fix librelp integration CI by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2766](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2766)
- Implement -passin for dgst cli by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2763](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2763)
- AL2023 x509-limbo container by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2761](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2761)
- Migrate Graviton2 and Graviton4 from EC2 Test Framework by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2759](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2759)
- Add Windows Docker Image Build by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2760](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2760)
- Do no consider warnings fatal in CPU Jitter for LTO build by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2769](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2769)
- Add more options to genrsa by [@​smittals2](https://redirect.github.com/smittals2) in [aws#2770](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2770)
- Prepare v1.62.1 by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2771](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2771)

##### New Contributors

- [@​AdnaneKhan](https://redirect.github.com/AdnaneKhan) made their first contribution in [aws#2762](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2762)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v1.62.0...v1.62.1>

### [`v1.62.0`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.62.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.61.4...v1.62.0)

##### Post release edit

- This release contains a bug in the AES-XTS implementation on aarch64 platforms affecting input lengths of 17 to 31 bytes.

##### What's Changed

- nginx now supports AWS-LC by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2714](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2714)

- Fixing a bug in ML-DSA poly\_uniform function by [@​dkostic](https://redirect.github.com/dkostic) in [aws#2721](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2721)
- Migrate integration omnibus by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2715](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2715)
- Delete util/bot directory by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2723](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2723)

- Bump urllib3 from 2.2.3 to 2.5.0 in /tests/ci by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#2551](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2551)
- Type fix in mldsa by [@​manastasova](https://redirect.github.com/manastasova) in [aws#2308](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2308)
- Centralize password handling tool-openssl by [@​kingstjo](https://redirect.github.com/kingstjo) in [aws#2555](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2555)
- crypto/pem: replace strncmp with CRYPTO\_memcmp to fix -Wstring-compare error by [@​R3hankhan123](https://redirect.github.com/R3hankhan123) in [aws#2724](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2724)
- Implement dgst CLI command by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2638](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2638)
- Add ASN.1 decoding for ML-KEM private keys as seeds by [@​jakemas](https://redirect.github.com/jakemas) in [aws#2707](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2707)
- Implement genrsa command by [@​kingstjo](https://redirect.github.com/kingstjo) in [aws#2535](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2535)
- Move udiv and sencond tweak calculations to when needed by [@​nebeid](https://redirect.github.com/nebeid) in [aws#2726](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2726)
- Add null check on RSA key checks by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2727](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2727)
- Implement workaround for FORTIFY\_SOURCE warning with jitterentropy by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2728](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2728)
- Implement coverity suggestions by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2730](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2730)
- Add minimal EC CLI tool implementation by [@​kingstjo](https://redirect.github.com/kingstjo) in [aws#2640](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2640)
- Adding pkeyutl tool to the CLI by [@​smittals2](https://redirect.github.com/smittals2) in [aws#2575](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2575)
- Add CI dimensions for legacy AVX512 flags by [@​smittals2](https://redirect.github.com/smittals2) in [aws#2732](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2732)
- Fix Libwebsockets CI by [@​smittals2](https://redirect.github.com/smittals2) in [aws#2737](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2737)
- Add option ENABLE\_SOURCE\_MODIFICATION by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2739](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2739)
- Simple script to build/run tests by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2736](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2736)
- Add build-time option to opt-out of CPU Jitter Entropy by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2733](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2733)
- Prepare v1.62.0 by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2743](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2743)

##### New Contributors
